newsitem.title: USA: Consumers shuts 780 MW Palisades nuke.
newsitem.headline: Consumers shuts 780 MW Palisades nuke.

text.p: Consumers Power Co shut its 780 megawatt Palisades nuclear power plant in South Haven, Mich., Thursday for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was "shut down to repair flexible connection between generator and isophase bus," the NRC said Friday in its daily plant status report.
The unit had been operating at 100 percent of capacity earlier Thursday, the NRC said.
A company spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
Consumers is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp, based in Dearborn, Mich.
